research.title: Sustainable Fuels Literature Review
research.description: Systematic review of the OpenAlex academic corpus focusing on sustainable fuels, their environmental impact, combustion properties, and the application of machine learning in fuel research. The pipeline filters works by keyword co-occurrence (fuel + impact terms), classifies them via OpenAI Batch API, and supports inter-rater QA.

subsets.name: Open access + LLM classified
subsets.sql: SELECT * FROM filtered_records WHERE is_oa = 1 AND fuel_relevant IS NOT NULL

subsets.name: Open access + fuel relevant
subsets.sql: SELECT * FROM filtered_records WHERE is_oa = 1 AND fuel_relevant = 1

subsets.name: Open access + fuel relevant + ML
subsets.sql: SELECT * FROM filtered_records WHERE is_oa = 1 AND fuel_relevant = 1 AND uses_ml = 1

openalex_id.description: Unique OpenAlex work identifier (e.g. W1234567890), used as primary key

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier for the work

is_oa.description: Whether the work is open access (1=yes, 0=no)

abstract_text.description: Reconstructed abstract text from OpenAlex inverted index

publication_date.description: Full publication date as ISO string

language.description: Language of the work (always 'en' due to pre-filter)

open_access_any_repository_has_fulltext.description: Whether any repository hosts the full text

open_access_oa_status.description: OA status: gold, green, hybrid, bronze, closed

open_access_oa_url.description: Best open-access URL for the work

primary_location_is_oa.description: Whether the primary location is open access

primary_location_landing_page_url.description: Landing page URL at the primary source

primary_location_license.description: License at the primary location (e.g. cc-by)

primary_location_source_display_name.description: Journal or source name where the work is published

primary_location_source_type.description: Source type: journal, repository, conference, etc.

has_fulltext.description: Whether OpenAlex has indexed the full text

best_oa_location_license.description: License at the best open-access location

best_oa_location_pdf_url.description: Direct PDF URL at the best OA location

best_oa_location_version.description: Version at the best OA location (publishedVersion, acceptedVersion, etc.)

authors_institutions.description: JSON array of objects with author names and their institution affiliations

authors_countries.description: JSON array of country codes extracted from author affiliations

matched_fuel_terms.description: JSON array of fuel keyword terms that matched in title/abstract

matched_impact_terms.description: JSON array of impact keyword terms that matched in title/abstract

matched_fuel_stems.description: JSON array of stemmed fuel terms that matched

matched_impact_stems.description: JSON array of stemmed impact terms that matched

matched_fuel_subgroups.description: JSON array of fuel keyword subgroup names that matched (e.g. ["Diesel & HVO", "Jet Fuels & SAF"])

matched_impact_subgroups.description: JSON array of impact keyword subgroup names that matched (e.g. ["GHG & Carbon", "Engine Performance"])

cited_by_count.description: Number of citations according to OpenAlex

primary_location_source_issn_l.description: Linking ISSN of the primary source journal

is_retracted.description: Whether the work has been retracted (1=yes, 0=no)

fuel_relevant.description: LLM classification: whether the work is relevant to hydrocarbon fuels (1=yes, 0=no)

research_field.description: LLM-assigned research field code: engine_emissions, engine_performance, combustion_dynamics, fuel_characterization, fuel_processing, sustainability, molecular_design, or none

uses_ml.description: LLM classification: whether the paper uses ML/AI as a substantive tool (1=yes, 0=no)

confidence.description: LLM self-reported confidence level: high, medium, or low

justification.description: LLM explanation for its classification decisions

llm_result_raw.description: Raw LLM output text (fallback when JSON parsing fails)

llm_batch_id.description: OpenAI batch job ID that produced this classification

llm_processed_at.description: ISO timestamp when LLM classification was saved

llm_tokens_input.description: Number of input tokens consumed for this work's classification

llm_tokens_output.description: Number of output tokens generated for this work's classification

llm_tokens_reasoning.description: Number of reasoning tokens used (for reasoning models)
